answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The saffron lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the beacon is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the gale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
